node.statement: For the given hiddenness dual witness (lambda, alpha, beta), the external lemma lem-hiddenness-dual-witness supplies the usable witness properties: lambda_f >= 0 on F_v with sum_f lambda_f = 1, alpha_i >= 0 and beta_i >= 0 for all i, sum_i beta_i < kappa = tau/4, and sum_f lambda_f*(p_f-p_v) + sum_i alpha_i*(p_i-p_v) = sum_i beta_i*(p_i-p_v).
